title: Constant Radius
source_docs: Vehicle Dynamics Blockset/Vehicle Scenarios/Drive Cycle and Maneuvers/Constant_Radius.md
text: 生成用于跟踪恒定半径路径的命令，输入 4 路、输出 2 路；{Maneuver start time, tStart [s]} 指定开始时间、{Longitudinal velocity setpoint, velRef} 指定目标速度、{Longitudinal velocity setpoint units, velRefUnit []} 指定单位 mph、{R} 指定要跟踪的半径、{Initial longitudinal position, X_o [m]} 指定初始纵向起点、{Initial lateral position, Y_o [m]} 指定初始横向起点、{Initial yaw angle, psi_o [rad]} 指定起始航向角、{Distance between inside and outside cone boundaries, radialConeDist [m]} 指定锥桶之间的径向距离、{Lateral acceleration absolute threshold, ayMax [g]} 指定仿真停止前允许的最大横向加速度、{Maneuver direction, steerDir} 指定机动方向 Right、{Stop simulation at lateral acceleration threshold} 用于在横向加速度阈值处停止仿真、{Instantiate 3D cones (Simulation 3D Scene Configuration required)} 用于实例化 3D 锥桶，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 车辆质心纵向位置 scalar

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: 车辆质心横向位置 scalar

params.name: R
params.values: 要跟踪的半径 100 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Distance between inside and outside cone boundaries, radialConeDist [m]
params.values: 锥桶之间的径向距离 6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Lateral acceleration absolute threshold, ayMax [g]
params.values: 仿真停止前允许的最大横向加速度 0.5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Stop simulation at lateral acceleration threshold
params.values: 用于在横向加速度阈值处停止仿真的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Instantiate 3D cones (Simulation 3D Scene Configuration required)
params.values: 用于实例化 3D 锥桶的选项 off (default) | on
